record.reason: Combiner proposes sub-quadratic attention and evaluates Wiki-40B autoregressive language modeling, image generation, LRA and masked LM with runtime/memory analysis. It does not show LLM-scale serving/deployment comparisons, so relevance to modern LLM inference remains uncertain.
